description: Source code for Mattermost server API endpoints related to local configuration management, including fetching, updating, patching, migrating, and retrieving client configuration.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API class that handles configuration-related endpoints.

methods.name: InitConfigLocal
methods.description: Initializes API routes for configuration management.

methods.name: localGetConfig
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve current configuration with optional filters.

methods.name: localUpdateConfig
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update the entire configuration.

methods.name: localPatchConfig
methods.description: Handles PATCH request to partially update the configuration.

methods.name: localMigrateConfig
methods.description: Handles POST request to migrate configuration from one version to another.

methods.name: localGetClientConfig
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve client configuration with computed values.
